tour.title: Ask to continue
tour.say: When you press Continue or Break open, the server loads your map and asks the interpreter to grow the branch you currently have selected.

tour.title: Model proposes moves
tour.say: The model never rewrites the whole board; it proposes a short list of typed operations, which are translated and checked before anything changes.
tour.evidence: interpreter.rs:249 translate, :628 interpret; live-thinking-map.md 'the model proposes bounded operations'

tour.title: Deterministic reducer
tour.say: A deterministic reducer applies the whole batch atomically, rejecting it entirely if any operation breaks authority, revision, or structural rules.

tour.title: Durable map history
tour.say: Accepted changes are saved per workspace with an event log, so maps can be replayed, restored as branches, or repaired after a crash.

tour.title: Map builds itself
tour.say: In listen mode, each finalized thing you say in an attached voice or meeting session is mapped automatically, using the message id to avoid duplicates.

tour.title: Reorganize on approval
tour.say: Reorganize asks the model for a restructure proposal, and nothing moves until you confirm or reject it on the proposal card.

tour.title: Canvas shows provenance
tour.say: The web canvas lays nodes out as a tree and draws AI-suggested ideas dashed, so you can tell them apart from what you said.

tour.title: Recall enough to understand
tour.say: Search hydrates readable passages with nearby source context. Repeated hits share bounded space, so one conversation cannot crowd out every other memory.

tour.title: Remember outcomes, not runtime noise
tour.say: An episode recalls what the task achieved and the original intent, with bounded readable text, rather than replaying another run’s instructions.

tour.title: Prepare context with progress
tour.say: Before answering, Magician shows context preparation progress. Memory and playbook lookups share a deadline, retaining useful results that finish in time.

tour.title: Reuse recalled context
tour.say: Shared retrieval work and bounded caches avoid repeating the same search. New memory changes invalidate cached results so later turns see updated facts.

tour.title: Keep prompt memory warm
tour.say: Repeated turns reuse a bounded memory snapshot. A retrieval deadline does not cancel its build, so later turns can use completed work.

tour.title: Refresh only changed content
tour.say: When memory changes, refresh reuses unaffected documents and search metadata. Touching or rewriting identical content does not rebuild the snapshot.
